comment: botl.c eval_notify_windowport_field() (1590) and get_hilite() (2536-2538) with a name typed at the 'Who are you?' prompt. bot_via_windowport() (995-998) cuts the Wizard's 27-byte name to 30 - 5 - strlen("Evoker") = 19 bytes, so get_hilite()'s txtstr, which skips strlen(svp.plname) + 5 bytes, starts past the 30-byte title. The title's val is not empty, so its 'always' rule still applies; power/down marks the spell's cost. Seed, clock, name and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
